narrative: Description Since 2009, HIDDEN COBRA actors have leveraged their capabilities to target and compromise a range of victims; some intrusions have resulted in the exfiltration of data while others have been disruptive in nature. Tools and capabilities used by HIDDEN COBRA actors include [REDACTED_MALWARE] botnets, keyloggers, remote access tools (RATs), and wiper malware. The malware operates on victims’ systems as a svchost-based service and is capable of downloading executables, changing its own configuration, updating its own binaries, terminating its own processes, and activating and terminating denial-of-service attacks.
